title: Neural Network

plan.insight: A hidden layer bends the decision boundary; training adjusts weights until the regions match the data.
plan.user_changes: hidden units, learning rate, train/step, drag the probe point
plan.reacts: network weights and activations for the probe, decision regions, loss curve, accuracy

init:
const pts = range(60).map(() => { const x = rand() * 2 - 1, y = rand() * 2 - 1; return [round(x, 2), round(y, 2), x * y > 0 ? 1 : 0]; });
return { pts, net: mlpInit([2, state.hidden, 1]), loss: [], epoch: 0 };

components.label: Hidden units
components.onChange: return { hidden: value, net: mlpInit([2, value, 1]), loss: [], epoch: 0 };

components.label: Train
New weights
components.onClick: return { net: mlpInit([2, state.hidden, 1]), loss: [], epoch: 0 };

components.title: Decision regions (drag the probe)
Network at the probe
components.draw: return [mlpGraph(state.net, mlpForward(state.net, state.probe).acts, { id: 'net', showValues: true })];
